# Atlaso automated contribution instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and its Mandatory Agent Startup Gate and applicable conditional routes.
Before every PR review, load [the complete-review contract](../docs/contribute/pr-workflow.md#complete-review-before-publication).
Analyze the complete PR and internally verify findings before one consolidated actionable review.
Do not repeatedly review an unchanged head without material new evidence; re-review relevant commits.
Sensitive findings follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) before publication.
